summary: Nothing this mission does can reach a broker, a public channel, or the owner's live alerts.
howRealOrdersAreRuledOut: The work is historical simulation over parquet files and a local dolt clone. No broker client is imported, no order function is called, and no paper-trading endpoint is touched. The Schwab credentials on this machine are for reading quotes and are not used by any file in this mission.
howOutputStaysPrivate: Results are written to files under .omc/research and .omx/outcome-loop and reported to the owner in this session only. Nothing is posted to Discord, nothing is pushed to GitHub, no alert flag is flipped on.
facts: no order path of any kind, real or paper
no production alert touched, output stays with the owner
